items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: I never shall forget we went to play the Silver Slipper in Memphis. And Eddie Miller and Badouk and Ben Pollock and Goodman and all that.

ctx.x: Well, Eddie Miller, for instance, is a fine man. Ray Badouk. They all have been fine troopers and fine bandsmen. And one thing I could always admire about them, they always, uh, they were always dignified in their profession, in their business.
